EXPLORE SABRE AGREEMENT

This Subscriber Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into as of the date of the last of the signature by and between Red Sparrow Tourism Consultancy DMCC a company existing under the laws of the United Arab Emirates with company registration number DMCC 900541 and having its registered office at Unit No: 3582, DMCC Business Centre, Level No. 1, Jewellery & Gemplex 3, Dubai, United Arab Emirates ("Red Sparrow") and the below identified Subscriber.

ARC/IATA/ERSP: _______________ Address: _______________
City: Cairo    Country: Egypt Term of Agreement: Sixty (60) months
Effective Date: {{ doc.start_date }}
1. Agreement Introduction
  • Red Sparrow is licensed by Sabre Travel Network Middle East Co. W.L.L to market, distribute and provide support for the Licensed Sabre System to travel agents ("Subscriber") in Egypt.
  • Subscriber desire to access the Sabre system for purpose of making travel arrangements for itself and its customers.
  • Territory shall mean EGYPT
  • Currency unless otherwise indicated all figures and charges referred to in this agreement are expressed in united states dollars (USD/$)
2. Segment Incentive

(a) If in any Year of the Agreement, Subscriber is in compliance with the terms and conditions of the Agreement and processes 250 Sabre Segment annually, Red Sparrow shall pay to Subscriber an amount per Sabre Segment ("Segment Incentive") within (75) days after the end of each Year during the Term.

Sabre Segment in applicable Measurement Period Booking Incentive
1 and above USD 1.00
Sabre NDC Segment in applicable Measurement Period Booking Incentive
1 and above USD 0.50

Year shall mean a twelve-month period commencing on the Effective Date and on each subsequent anniversary of the Effective Date.

The subscriber agrees that the airline participants may from time to time have programs which provide to members of the program special benefits (e.g. full content and/or service fee protection) upon payment by subscriber of a program fees and/or reduction of booking incentive payable to subscriber by Red Sparrow.

In the event subscriber elects to participate in any such program, Red Sparrow and subscriber will enter into an amendment to the agreement providing for subscriber’s participation in such program and the associated program fee payable by subscriber and/or booking incentive payment reduction for bookings processed through such program.

Sabre NDC Segment in applicable Measurement Period, Red Sparrow shall pay to subscriber an amount per Sabre NDC segment made pursuant to this agreement in accordance with the table above " Segment Incentive " except that all bookings incentive shall be paid back to segment one according strictly to the relevant incentive tier attained during the respective year as shown in the table.

The Subscriber agrees that each participant airline may from time to time reduce or cancel the NDC booking incentive payable to subscriber by Red Sparrow in anytime during the deal term.

3. Terminal Addresses
